top_issues.issue: Narrow layouts preserve a desktop-width sidebar at the expense of the task pane.
top_issues.evidence: Rail plus list occupies x=0–363 at 760 px width: 47.9%; channel body starts around x=437, leaving only 290 px of readable line width.
top_issues.fix: Below 900 pt, collapse the 300 pt list behind a back/list control or reduce it to 220 pt; preserve at least 440 pt for messages and primary tasks.

top_issues.issue: Tinted-input placeholder text narrowly fails WCAG 2.2 body-text contrast.
top_issues.evidence: Pillow sampled strongest glyph cores #727376 against #F6F6F7: 4.390:1. Examples: chats (86,68), calls (423,236), status-message (452,219). Setup uses the same pair in its ID placeholder. Disabled Save/Join text was excluded.
top_issues.fix: Use placeholder #62656D on #F6F6F7 (about 5.4:1), retaining at least 13 pt type. Recheck all placeholder renderings.

top_issues.issue: White-field placeholder text also fails the 4.5:1 threshold.
top_issues.evidence: Strongest glyph #767779 on #FFFFFF: 4.482:1; chats (395,737), search-switcher (386,111). No antialiased edge pixels were used as the foreground.
top_issues.fix: Use #62656D on white (5.83:1), including the switcher and composer placeholder. Dark placeholder #9B9B9F on #25262B measures 5.45:1 and passes.

top_issues.issue: Failed-send feedback does not provide a visible recovery path tied to the failed message.
top_issues.evidence: Toast at x=370–910, y=638–692 says Retry in a moment, but shows only a close icon. No Sending failed marker or Retry control is visible on a message.
top_issues.fix: Show a persistent Failed to send label and a 32 pt-high Retry action beneath the failed message; keep a concise toast above the composer with at least 12 pt clearance from message content.

top_issues.issue: Hover action strips obscure sender metadata.
top_issues.evidence: Chats strip spans approximately x=444–732, y=268–306 over Alex Rivera at y≈301; channel strip x=506–738, y=333–371 overlaps Hedy Lamarr and timestamp at y≈370. Pointer hover is expected, but content occlusion remains a defect.
top_issues.fix: Reserve a 36 pt action band above the sender row, or place a compact overflow button in a dedicated 32 pt trailing column; ensure at least 8 pt between toolbar bounds and text.

top_issues.issue: Composer boundaries do not meet 3:1 non-text contrast; the focused long draft has no distinct focus treatment.
top_issues.evidence: Light border #DFDFE3 against #FFFFFF: 1.329:1. Dark border #303137 against #25262B: 1.165:1. Long-draft top edge at y=551 has the same pair despite the supplied focused state.
top_issues.fix: Use #8E9199 for light input outlines and #787C87 for dark outlines, 1 pt stroke. Add a 2 pt #AD520C light / #EF913B dark focus outline with a 2 pt offset.

top_issues.issue: Call status and action wording leave the current meeting state unclear.
top_issues.evidence: Top bar says In the meeting · just joined; the same meeting transcript says Meeting ended: 58 min · 09:35 at y≈502 (380 px) or y≈442 (720 px). Done appears alongside Restore without clarifying its effect.
top_issues.fix: Use a 14 pt In call heading with the meeting start time; distinguish earlier meeting-ended events with their date. Rename Done to the actual outcome, such as Close call panel, and use a 32 pt-high control.

top_issues.issue: Long draft scrolling and send placement lack clear affordances.
top_issues.evidence: Draft occupies y=552–764; column_108 is cut at the upper edge, no scrollbar is visible, and send/attachment icons sit halfway down at y≈658.
top_issues.fix: Keep 12 pt top/bottom inner padding, show a 6 pt scroll thumb with 3:1 contrast, add a 13 pt draft position/line indicator, and anchor actions to the editor bottom-right with 12 pt inset.

top_issues.issue: The Calls view prioritises implementation and capability prose over placing a call.
top_issues.evidence: At 760×640, introductory prose fills y=108–187 and capability content starts at y=338; Incoming calls is clipped at the bottom. At 1280×800, five explanatory blocks occupy y=305–673.
top_issues.fix: Place the join field directly below the 24 pt title with 16 pt spacing; condense limitations into a 14 pt notice and put the detailed explanation behind a disclosure. Give recent people 44 pt rows.

top_issues.issue: Wide chat rows are not bounded for comfortable reading or local action discovery.
top_issues.evidence: Main pane spans x=364–1919; highlighted message spans x=372–1908 while its text/quote begins at x=432. Hover actions appear at x≈1660, over 1200 px from the author.
top_issues.fix: Cap the message content column at 880 pt and locate its action strip at the column edge; use remaining space as gutters rather than extending the interactive row.

top_issues.issue: Technical copy interrupts routine preferences and weak scrolling cues hide further settings.
top_issues.evidence: Refresh explanation takes three lines at y=436–475 between checkboxes. Dark scrollbar #2C2D33 on #25262B is 1.10:1; light #EEEEF0 on white is about 1.16:1. Content is cut at y=719.
top_issues.fix: Move refresh-policy details into a 13 pt help disclosure; group settings with 24 pt section gaps. Use a 6 pt scrollbar thumb #8E9199 light / #8E9199 dark and retain a clear bottom continuation cue.

top_issues.issue: Attachment controls and metadata are too compressed for confident review before sending.
top_issues.evidence: Image tiles are approximately 144×96 px at y=622–718; tall image is heavily cropped. Close discs are approximately 22 px. File removal in mention composer is a tiny x beside 177 KB at y≈701.
top_issues.fix: Use contain-fit thumbnails in 144×112 pt tiles, show filename/dimensions in 12 pt text, and provide 24×24 pt removal targets with 4 pt separation from image content.

top_issues.issue: Search guidance is packed into a tiny two-line footer.
top_issues.evidence: At x=354–930, y=607–628, keyboard instructions and cache/Microsoft Search scope share roughly 11 pt type and wrap the final word onto a new line.
top_issues.fix: Use 13 pt footer text, separate key hints and search scope into two rows with 8 pt gap, and provide 16 pt bottom padding.

top_issues.issue: Authentication screens repeat a very long small-print footer with weak proximity to its related card.
top_issues.evidence: Footer runs approximately x=212–1068, a line length of 856 px; signin card is only x=405–875 (470 px). Footer y position changes with each card height.
top_issues.fix: Constrain footer to 470 pt, use 13 pt type and 18 pt line height, align it with the card, and keep a consistent 24 pt gap after the last action.

top_issues.issue: Empty-state compositions sit noticeably high in a large blank pane.
top_issues.evidence: Icon starts at y=216; title at y≈299, while main pane centre is y=400. The repeated composition leaves over 400 px blank below the explanatory text.
top_issues.fix: Centre the complete icon/title/body/action group within the pane excluding the header; use 16 pt icon-to-title, 8 pt title-to-body, and 20 pt body-to-action spacing.

top_issues.issue: Presence and preference symbols are visually ambiguous at small sizes.
top_issues.evidence: Busy and Do not disturb both show an identical red disc at x=79, y≈549/579. Settings uses approximately 14 px circular outlines for independent checkboxes.
top_issues.fix: Use a white minus inside the Do not disturb disc and clock detail for away; use 16 pt square checkboxes with a 2 pt check and 8 pt label gap.
